units.name: C’tan Shard of the Void Dragon
keywords: C’tan Shard of the Void Dragon

profiles.name: C’tan Shard of the Void Dragon
Necron Warrior with Gauss Reaper and Combat Attachments

abilities.name: Their Number is Legion
abilities.community_notes: Each time this unit's Reanimation Protocols activate, re-roll the dice determining how many wounds are reanimated.

abilities.name: Engrammatic Logic
abilities.community_notes: [APPROX] Once per battle, at the start of any phase, the bearer selects one friendly NECRONS unit that is Battle-shocked and within 12", and that unit is no longer Battle-shocked. Battle-shock remains implicit in remove-battle-shock; full rule in raw-text store.

abilities.name: Necrodermis
abilities.community_notes: defensive: -1 to incoming damage (floored at 1 by the engine)

abilities.name: Infectious Murder-Madness (Aura)
abilities.community_notes: [APPROX] Aura (6"): a friendly NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTER and TITANIC) within range grants each of its attacks [SUSTAINED HITS 1] when the attacking model is DESTROYER CULT. The rules text's alternate OR-branch (an attack into the closest eligible target also qualifies) is a per-attack, per-target gate the schema has no leaf for and is not modeled here; only the DESTROYER CULT keyword branch is represented.

abilities.name: Tectonic Reverberations
abilities.community_notes: [APPROX] Selection is restricted to an enemy unit within 18" of and visible to this model; that 18"/visibility restriction is not encoded, and the mark's until-your-next-Movement-phase window is modeled as one battle round. Pinned debuff (−2 Move, −2 to Charge rolls) mirrors the grav-pinned encoding. Full rule in raw-text store.

abilities.name: Obelisk Node Control
abilities.community_notes: [APPROX] While the bearer is within range of an objective marker it controls, the enemy Reserves-setup exclusion zone around it is pushed out to 12"; the proximity and control conditions are modeled as an AND of two predicates rather than bound to the same objective marker ([APPROX] same-objective binding).

abilities.name: Teleportation Matrix
abilities.community_notes: [APPROX] Once per battle. When it returns in the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase it may be set up anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" horizontally from all enemy models; that placement distance and the arrival-timing detail are not modeled by the redeploy-to-reserves effect. Also not modeled: if the battle ends while this unit is off the battlefield, it is destroyed.

effect.choice_label: for each of up to 3 selected friendly NECRONS units

abilities.name: Hypermotility Protocols
abilities.community_notes: Applies per-unit to friendly Immortals and Necron Warriors: their ranged weapons gain [Assault], and being selected to Advance does not stop them starting an Action. The detachment's DYNASTY tag / mutual-exclusion is list-construction metadata, not modeled as an effect here.

abilities.name: Transdimensional Deployment
abilities.community_notes: Applies to friendly TOMB BLADES units: they gain Deep Strike, and their ranged attacks get +1 to Hit in a turn they made an ingress (Deep Strike) move.

abilities.name: Empowered Engines
abilities.community_notes: Applies to friendly NECRONS TITANIC FLY units: +6" Move.

abilities.name: Recursive Reanimation
abilities.community_notes: TOMB BLADES enhancement: add 1 to the roll when the bearer's unit activates its Reanimation Protocols.

abilities.name: Subsurface Quantumweave
abilities.community_notes: [APPROX] Reactive defensive stratagem used when an enemy unit targets a friendly NECRONS TITANIC FLY unit in your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase: attacks that target your unit have Armour Penetration 1 until that enemy unit has finished attacking. Modeled as setting attacker AP to 1; the scoping to only the triggering enemy unit and the 'until it has attacked' window are not fully encoded. Full rule in raw-text store.

abilities.name: Prelocational Optimiser

effect.choice_label: Ranged attacks gain (when selected to shoot)

abilities.community_notes: [APPROX] Applies only when the bearer's unit was set up this turn using a Monolith's Eternity Gate ability; when it is then selected to shoot, its ranged attacks gain either [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. The Eternity-Gate deployment precondition is not expressible in the condition set. Full rule in raw-text store.

abilities.name: Technosorcerous Augmentations

effect.choice_prompt: Select one weapon ability to apply until the end of the phase

abilities.community_notes: Detachment rule: CRYPTEK ranged weapons gain [ASSAULT]; additionally, each time a CRYPTEK unit is selected to shoot, one listed weapon ability may be chosen for its ranged weapons until end of phase.

abilities.name: Relentless Onslaught
abilities.community_notes: [APPROX] +1 to Hit applies to NECRONS attacks (excluding MONSTER models) targeting a unit within range of an objective marker; the [ASSAULT] grant applies only to NECRONS VEHICLE and MOUNTED (excluding TITANIC) ranged weapons. Those keyword restrictions are not encoded. Full rule in raw-text store.

abilities.name: Cold Fervour
abilities.community_notes: [APPROX] Step 1 (+2 Strength to DESTROYER CULT weapons) is always on. Step 2 fires the first time each turn a DESTROYER CULT unit destroys an enemy unit or brackets it below half-strength, granting +2 Strength to other friendly NECRONS weapons (excluding DESTROYER CULT/MONSTER/TITANIC) until end of turn; the kill trigger, the keyword exclusions, and the until-end-of-turn window are not encoded. Full rule in raw-text store.

abilities.name: Annihilation Protocol
abilities.community_notes: [APPROX] Charge re-roll and the +1 Charge (when a charge target is Below Half-strength) apply to DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES units; the +1 Armour Penetration applies only to DESTROYER CULT ranged attacks that target the closest eligible target. The per-keyword scoping and the closest-target restriction are not encoded, and unit-below-half-strength approximates the target being below half. Full rule in raw-text store.

abilities.name: Hyperphasing
abilities.community_notes: [APPROX] At the end of your opponent's turn, remove the selected NECRONS units to Strategic Reserves. The maximum selectable scales with battle size (Incursion 1 / Strike Force 2 / Onslaught 3) and is encoded at the Onslaught cap of 3; the end-of-opponent's-turn timing and the exclusion of units within Engagement Range are not encoded. Full rule in raw-text store.

abilities.name: Cosmic Distortion
abilities.community_notes: [APPROX] Grants NECRONS MONSTER units the Distortion Fields aura: an enemy unit within 6" is 'unravelling', so attacks targeting it improve Armour Penetration by 1. The optional 3-mortal-wound extension of the aura to 9" and the model-specific C'tan binding abilities in the store text are not encoded. Full rule in raw-text store.

abilities.name: Worthy Foes
abilities.community_notes: Detachment rule: in your Command phase mark one enemy unit; friendly NOBLE, LYCHGUARD or TRIARCH units add 1 to Wound rolls against it until the start of your next Command phase.

abilities.name: Power Matrix
abilities.community_notes: The named region permanently starts as the army's deployment zone, with each other zone added for a phase only after the army controls at least half of that zone's objective markers at phase start. Eligible CRYPTEK and CANOPTEK units re-roll Hit rolls of 1, or re-roll the Hit roll instead while wholly within the region.
